decisions.reason: Real campaign: AI agents (Hermes/OpenClaw) compromised Asian government entities, exfiltrated thousands of records. Belongs with the existing AI-agents-government story.
Vendor marketing: Cortex Cloud KuppingerCole analyst report positioning. No security event.
Active exploitation: 270+ Zimbra instances compromised via CVE-2026-73570 (SNMP command injection, RCE). CISA KEV, 3-day FCEB patch mandate. Already covered by existing story.
Active scam campaign: fake Microsoft 'SysScan' sites tricking users into remote access and data theft. Merges into existing fake-Microsoft-scanner story.
Critical vuln: CVE-2026-59568, CVSS 9.1, unauthenticated RCE in Zscaler Client Connector for Windows. Patched in 4.8.0.232 (June 2026). Same story as existing Zscaler flaws entry.
Data breach: ASOS notifying US customers after credential-stuffing account takeovers detected July 28. Same incident as existing ASOS story.
Same CVE-2026-59568 Zscaler Client Connector RCE as mf:161350. Both belong in existing Zscaler story.
